accepts.because: one closed session as a single write batch; the ledger is keyed on the promoted session_id and a batch without one cannot be told apart from its own repeat. The provenance of the turns travels the same way and is NOT optional (#269): `audience_set` (a JSON list of participants in affinity vocabulary, `*` alone meaning universal) and `channel` are required on a batch that carries turns, because the memory hive's own in_episode lane requires them and this adapter is the thing that speaks that lane. Without either, the batch is refused on `reject` and NOTHING is written to the ledger -- a guessed audience is worse than a missing turn, and a batch consumed into the ledger but refused downstream would be lost for good

emits.because: one message per turn of the batch, for the memory hive's in_episode lane

a batch this adapter would not take: the participant set or the room is not on it (`hop.reject_reason` is then 'missing_audience' or 'missing_channel'), or the adapter's own ledger did not answer the op it was asked (`store_refused`, with the ledger's code in `hop.store_error` and the refused op in `hop.store_operation` -- GH #343; that variant is a REPORT, not a refusal to take the batch: refused at the last step of the chain the episodes have already left, and the body names the step so a reader is not told the opposite of what happened). The body says which and why. For the two PROVENANCE reasons nothing was parked and nothing was marked, so the same batch delivered again over an edge that carries its provenance still drains whole; for 'store_refused' how much had already happened depends on the step, and the body names it. Drain it: undrained, nobody ever learns that the day never became a memory

required_drains.because: since 2.0.2 a batch without a participant set or without a room is REFUSED at this adapter's own door rather than decomposed into episodes the hive will refuse one by one (#269) -- undrained, the refusal is silent and the caller believes a day was remembered that never existed, which is the one failure this adapter exists to prevent

description.purpose: Scope marker of the drain hive: the adapter that turns ONE write batch - a whole transcript handed out as a single message - into N single-turn episodes on the memory hive's in_episode lane, plus the ledger that makes a second delivery a skip. It sits BEFORE the hive's `in_episode` lane and outside the hive (GH #101, R-MD-1): the memory hive is not changed by a single line. It is NOT part of a live conversational path any more (GH #298, ruling Q11) and no shipped topology wires it: a collector emits one message per turn on `turn_write` itself, in the shape that lane reads, so a live turn has nothing left to decompose. What it is FOR is bulk import of foreign history - a benchmark haystack, an exported transcript from another agent, an archive month (ADR 0012). What this hive owns that nothing else in the distribution owns is the ledger - a re-delivered transcript is a skip, which is exactly what an interrupted import needs; that is the ground on which ADR 0012 keeps it, wired by nobody, with a named retirement trigger.
description.use_when: For an out-of-band bulk import of foreign history, and for nothing else (ADR 0012; GH #298, ruling Q11): nothing shipped wires it - the two examples that used to, do not any more. Not on a live conversational path -a talky's `turn_write` route already speaks the memory hive's in_episode lane one message per turn, and a decomposer beside it is a second minter over turns that lane already wrote. Where a batch really is a batch, wire the ports in the SAME mutation that instantiates it: the producer's batch route into ./drain as lane in_batch, ./drain's 'episode' route into the memory hive on its in_episode lane, and ./drain's 'reject' route wherever refusals are read. The edge that carries the batch IN owes it its provenance: context.audience_set and context.channel. In a colony whose channels sit in the `channels` level of `assistant@1.1.0` both are already in context from the ingress door of the generation (ADR-0002 E8) and nothing extra is needed; a tree that holds its channels some other way declares them on the in_batch edge itself.
description.contract_in: Every message whose `hop.route` starts with `in_`. One lane is in use: in_batch -- one closed session as a single write batch. The caller must promote `session_id` into `context` on its own edge; the ledger is keyed on it and a batch without one cannot be told apart from its own repeat. `context.audience_set` and `context.channel` must be in context too -- promoted upstream or on that same edge -- or the batch is refused; they are the memory hive's own requirement and this adapter only carries them through, it never invents them.
description.contract_out: `episode` -- one message per turn of the batch, for the memory hive's in_episode lane, leaving through the hive path. `reject` -- a batch that was not taken, with hop.reject_reason; it too leaves through the hive path and must be drained. The ledger write (`lstore`) stays inside: that a second delivery is a skip is this hive's promise, not something a caller arranges.
description.not_in_scope: Neither the fact path nor the episode path of a LIVE conversation passes through here any more (ADR 0012, GH #298 ruling Q11): both are written per turn, straight at the memory hive's in_episode lane. Not the transfer lane either (#243) - that moves a hive's OWN records between hives and re-derives nothing, while this turns foreign raw conversation into episodes. No extraction, no summarising, no recall, no LLM call - the write path is synchronous and model-free by spec. No second write path into memory: everything goes through the existing writer, which is the point of the adapter. No per-turn cadence: that used to be a second in_batch edge on the collector's `turn_write` route and it is retracted (GH #298, ruling Q11) - that route now carries ONE turn per message straight at the hive, and putting this adapter in front of it writes the same turns twice. No session lifecycle of its own; the keeper closes the session and the collector produces the batch. No provenance of its own: the participant set and the room are declared by the wiring and carried through untouched, never minted, never defaulted to `["*"]`.
